alerts.reason: July revenue fell just 0.28% year over year. Higher comparable-store sales and 32% growth in First Day programs helped offset store closures (A, B). I expect those gains to keep the intervening quarter above -5%. For the quarter starting October 27, I forecast a decline of at least 5% if fewer stores and tighter inventory funding erode that offset. Lower borrowing availability had already delayed vendor payments for inventory purchases (C).
